Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_rec number := :system.cursor_record;
 temp_print boolean := FALSE;
begin
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :donor_interdictions.print_yn = 'Y' THEN
 temp_print := TRUE;
 exit;
 end if;
 exit when :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 go_record(temp_rec);
 IF temp_print THEN
 print_proc;
 show_error('99003');
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 show_error('99002');
 END IF;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_DONOR IS
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.donor_id := null;
 call_form( lower('DNWDFIND') ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE);
 if :GLOBAL.donor_id is null then
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id := :GLOBAL.donor_id;
 begin
 SELECT last_name || ', ' || First_name 
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_name
 FROM Donors
 WHERE donor_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id;
 :system.message_level := 15;
 GO_BLOCK('DONOR_INTERDICTIONS');
 execute_query(NO_VALIDATE);
 :system.message_level := 5;
 /*synchronize;*/
 exception
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 IF :donor_interdictions.inter_code is null THEN
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_print',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE); 
 show_error('99004',:ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id);
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_PROC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_PROC IS
 cur_rec number(3) := :system.cursor_record;
 pl_id ParamList;
 v_parmid varchar2(20);
 v_systime varchar2(4) := to_char(sysdate,'MISS');
 v_desname varchar2(50); 
BEGIN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.cur_printer is null THEN
 GET_PRINTER;
 END IF;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.cur_printer is null THEN
 show_error('99001');
 check_package_failure; -- IM 531
 END IF;
 GO_BLOCK('DONOR_INTERDICTIONS');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 LOOP
 IF :DONOR_INTERDICTIONS.PRINT_YN = 'Y' THEN
 /* Replaced Call to Report by Call to package */
 LT_TIETAG_LABEL.GEN_SPTT_FILE(:CTRL_BLK_1.S_DONOR_ID,
 :DONOR_INTERDICTIONS.INTER_CODE,
 :DONOR_INTERDICTIONS.NO_OF_COPIES, 
 :CTRL_BLK_1.CUR_PRINTER,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id); -- IM 451, 508
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 go_record(cur_rec);
END;
